business_problem: Lillia needed to reduce the friction of manual meal, medication, and vital tracking for chronic disease patients while freeing human care coaches from routine tasks and still meeting enterprise reliability and data residency requirements.
solution_summary: Lillia rebuilt its digital care model around agentic AI on Google Cloud so patient onboarding, routine question answering, and health logging could be automated safely during the first weeks of care. Gemini APIs supply the intelligence layer for these autonomous workflows, while Google Kubernetes Engine Autopilot runs the containerized microservices that execute them with lower operational overhead. Cloud Build and Artifact Registry support deployment consistency, and Cloud Monitoring plus Cloud Logging provide the operational visibility needed as the platform scales. Around those core services, Lillia uses Cloud SQL, Google Cloud Storage, Identity and Access Management, Secret Manager, and Cloud Load Balancing to support application data, security, secrets, and traffic handling. Regional Google Cloud infrastructure also helps the company satisfy Middle East data residency requirements as it embeds the platform into enterprise clients and expands globally.
